# Auto policy summary

Keystone Auto policy for the Subaru, summarized from the declarations page.

## Coverage at a glance

Liability 100/300/100 (per person, per accident, property damage). Collision deductible $500. Comprehensive deductible $250. Uninsured motorist: included. Rental reimbursement: $40 a day. The premium is billed twice a year.

## Collision and comprehensive

Collision pays to repair our car after a crash with a car or an object, whoever is at fault, less the $500 deductible. Comprehensive pays for damage that does not come from a crash: theft of the car, a broken windshield, hail, fire, flood and hitting an animal, less the $250 deductible.

## Things stolen from the car

Personal belongings left in the car are not covered by the auto policy, whether the car was broken into or stolen. A permanently installed stereo or equipment is part of the car and is covered under comprehensive after the deductible. Anything we carry in the car, such as a laptop, phone or luggage, belongs under a renters or homeowners policy.

## Uninsured and underinsured motorists

Uninsured motorist coverage pays medical bills for us and our passengers when the driver who hit us has no insurance or flees the scene. Uninsured motorist property damage repairs our car up to $25,000 with a $250 deductible, but only when the other driver is identified. Underinsured coverage fills the gap when the other driver's limits are too low.

## Rental reimbursement

While our car is being repaired after a covered loss, the policy pays $40 a day, up to 30 days, for a rental car.

## After an accident

Move to safety, call 911 if anyone is hurt, take photos, and exchange insurance and license details. Report the claim within 24 hours and get a police report number. Do not admit fault at the scene.
